## [1.12.2] - 2026-07-01

v1.12.2

Disambiguate OpenSpec spec-divergence so fix rounds keep progressing (#356)

The stale-delta guard in enforceSpecConsistencyGuard now requires a structured
direction marker (spec-behind-code / code-behind-spec) correlated against the
current HEAD SHA via an injectable getHeadSha dep. A spec-divergence finding
from a prior review that predates the latest developer commit is treated as
unclassified — allowing normal fix rounds to proceed without being blocked by
a stale verdict. The guard only fires when the current-state direction is
positively spec-behind-code for the post-fix head.

Also fixes: maybeArchiveOpenspec now uses the injectable deps.getGhActor seam
(inherited from ShaGateDeps) instead of the bare module-level getGhActor(),
making archive-path unit tests deterministic in environments without gh auth.
7 archive-path tests updated to inject trustedReviewAuthor to avoid hitting
real network in CI.

## [1.7.0] - 2026-06-19

release: 1.7.0 — Control plane & release_model (#246)

* fix: release PR-number extraction takes last (#N) per line, not all

Pipeline squash commits carry both issue and PR numbers in the subject:
"[Pipeline] title (#issue) (#pr)". SQUASH_PR_RE matched every (# N)
on the line, so the issue number was fed to `gh pr view` as if it were
a PR, failing for every pipeline-managed commit and aborting the release.

Take only the last matchAll result per line — the squash-merge PR number
is always the trailing (# N).
